written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Hidden affection score: insult -2, apology +1, gift +1; warm if score > 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Hidden resentment: insult adds 2, apology removes 2, gift removes 1, clamped at 0; warm at 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Hidden trust and anger: insult raises anger by 2 and lowers trust by 1; apology lowers anger by 1 and raises trust by 1; gift raises trust by 1; warm when trust exceeds anger.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Hidden unforgiven insults: each insult adds one, each apology forgives one, gifts do nothing; warm only when none remain.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Resentment rises by 3 per insult, falls by 3 per apology and 1 per gift, but up to 1 lingering resentment still leaves Robin warm.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Hidden grudge in half-units: insults add 2, apologies forgive 3, gifts do nothing; only zero grudge is warm.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Insults and apologies act one-for-one, but a gift soothes only an already substantial resentment (at least 2), reducing it by 1.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Insults and apologies act one-for-one, but a gift makes an already substantial resentment worse (at least 2), increasing it by 1.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Insults double the current resentment and add 3; apologies remove 6; gifts remove 1; warm if resentment is at most 1.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Insults add 4; each apology cuts resentment to one third, rounded down; gifts subtract 1; warm if resentment is at most 1.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Insults add 3; apologies reset to 0 when resentment is at most 3, otherwise subtract 3; gifts subtract 1; warm if resentment is at most 1.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Insults add 2; apologies remove 3; gifts remove 1; only zero resentment is warm.

shown the survivors.comment: Robin tracks a grudge counter: insults add 1; gifts subtract 1 only if grudge>1; apologies subtract 1 and warm if grudge becomes 0 unless the previous action was also an apology; with no grudge, apologies flip mood and gifts warm.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin keeps hidden anger: insults add 1, apologies/gifts subtract 1 (min 0); an apology warms if it brings anger to 0, but consecutive apologies are ignored.
